- LuminaSec procurement indicated purchase orders are required for any over $10k/month spend.
- For pilots under $10k/month they can approve via credit card or expense.
- To streamline a PO route, I'm attaching a one-page estimate and a PO template that procurement prefers.

2) If procurement needs line-item pricing (model variant, estimated tokens, monthly not-to-exceed), should I produce a formal quote or would a simple one-page estimate suffice?
3) If PO is required, please loop in procurement and share their standard payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45 / other).

I'll wait for your confirmation and will prepare a formal one-pager tied to the band you pick.
